welcome.headline: A softer place for your <1>music library</1>.
welcome.description: Shiranami plays the files you already own. Folders you point it at. Nothing streamed, nothing watched, nothing recommended over your shoulder.

language.label: Language
language.hint: You can change this any time in Settings · Appearance.

folders.headline: Your folders are the <1>catalog</1>.
folders.description: Drop in directories. Shiranami scans your files, reads the tags, lifts cover art, and quietly hands you back a real library — no upload, no account, no maybe-it-syncs.
folders.title: Music folders
folders.empty: No folders yet. Add one to start building your library.
folders.desktopOnly: Adding folders is available in the desktop app.
folders.doneHint: Nice — your library is filling up. Add more or continue.

theme.headline: The window dresses for your <1>mood</1>.
theme.description: One quiet theme with five scenes. The whole interface — accent color, glow, surfaces — shifts to match. Swap any time from Settings · Appearance.
theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Tap any scene · the rain stays.

ready.headline: Open the door. <1>Press play</1>.
ready.description: That's it. The library is waiting. We'll keep your queue, run your radio, hand you the lyrics, and resume the song you left at 2:47 a.m.
ready.title: Choose a visualizer
ready.hint: Optional — the rhythm behind your now-playing bar. Change it any time.
